description: Colima's per-profile config file (~/.colima/<profile>/colima.yaml or $COLIMA_HOME/<profile>/colima.yaml, 'default' being the default profile). Based on the `Config` struct in https://github.com/abiosoft/colima/blob/main/config/config.go and the annotated template at https://github.com/abiosoft/colima/blob/main/embedded/defaults/colima.yaml; colima has no officially published JSON Schema of its own.

arch.description: Architecture of the virtual machine. Cannot be changed after the VM is created.

autoActivate.description: Set as the active Docker/Kubernetes/Incus context on startup

binfmt.description: Enable foreign architecture emulation via binfmt (e.g. amd64 on arm64)

cpu.description: Number of CPUs allocated to the virtual machine

cpuType.description: CPU type for the virtual machine (requires vmType 'qemu'). Options available for host emulation can be checked with `qemu-system-$(arch) -cpu help`; instructions can be appended, e.g. 'qemu64,+ssse3'.

disk.description: Disk size in GiB allocated to the virtual machine for container data. Can only be increased after the VM is created.

diskImage.description: File path to a custom disk image, overriding the image Colima would otherwise download from https://github.com/abiosoft/colima-core/releases

diskImageMirror.description: Mirror URL to replace the 'https://github.com' prefix when downloading disk images, e.g. behind a proxy or an artifact mirror

docker.description: Docker daemon configuration, merged directly into dockerd's daemon.json. Some keys (e.g. 'hosts') may affect Colima's ability to start docker.

proxies.description: Proxy configuration for the daemon and default proxy env vars for containers, missing from the upstream https://json.schemastore.org/dockerd.json schema as of writing, see https://docs.docker.com/engine/daemon/proxy/ and moby's daemon/config/config.go Proxies struct

env.description: Environment variables for the virtual machine

forceDiskImage.description: Load 'diskImage' even if it does not match a supported release image. Bypasses validation, unsupported.

forwardAgent.description: Forward the host's SSH agent to the virtual machine

hostname.description: Custom hostname for the virtual machine (default: 'colima', or 'colima-<profile>' for other profiles)

kubernetes.description: Kubernetes (k3s) configuration for the virtual machine

k3sArgs.description: Additional args passed to k3s, see https://docs.k3s.io/cli/server

port.description: Kubernetes API port to listen on (0 picks a random unbound port)

version.description: k3s version to use, must exactly match a release at https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/releases

memory.description: Memory size in GiB allocated to the virtual machine

modelRunner.description: AI model runner. Both require vmType 'krunkit' for GPU access.

mountInotify.description: Propagate inotify file events to the VM (experimental)

mounts.description: Volume mounts for the virtual machine. When omitted, $HOME is mounted as writable by default; an explicit empty list also falls back to that default.

mountPoint.description: Absolute path to mount at inside the VM, defaults to the same path as 'location'

mountType.description: Volume mount driver for the virtual machine. 'virtiofs' is macOS + vmType 'vz'/'krunkit' only and fastest; '9p' is the most stable option for vmType 'qemu'; 'sshfs' is faster than 9p but least reliable under heavy concurrent I/O. Cannot be changed after the VM is created.

nestedVirtualization.description: Enable nested virtualization (requires an M3 Mac and vmType 'vz')

network.description: Network configuration for the virtual machine. Most fields here are macOS only and ignored on Linux.

address.description: Assign a reachable IP address to the VM (macOS only). Cannot be disabled again once enabled.

dns.description: Custom DNS resolvers for the virtual machine, e.g. ['8.8.8.8', '1.1.1.1']

dnsHosts.description: DNS hostnames resolved to custom targets (IP or another host) via the internal resolver. Has no effect if custom DNS resolvers are set above; does not touch any /etc/hosts file.

gatewayAddress.description: Custom gateway address for the virtual machine. The last octet must be 2.

hostAddresses.description: Replicate host IP addresses in the VM, enabling port forwarding to specific host IP addresses (e.g. `docker run -p 10.0.1.2:8080:8080 ...`)

interface.description: Host network interface to use for 'bridged' mode

mode.description: Network mode for the virtual machine (macOS only)

preferredRoute.description: Use the assigned IP address as the preferred route for the VM. Only has an effect when 'address' is true.

portForwarder.description: Port forwarder for the virtual machine. 'ssh' is more stable but TCP only; 'grpc' supports TCP and UDP but is experimental; 'none' disables port forwarding.

provision.description: Custom provisioning scripts for the virtual machine, executed on every startup so scripts must be idempotent

mode.description: When/as whom the script runs. 'system' runs as root and 'user' as the VM user, both passed straight to Lima. 'after-boot' runs once the VM has booted but before container runtimes start; 'ready' runs once the VM and container runtimes are fully ready, both handled by Colima itself rather than Lima.

rootDisk.description: Disk size in GiB for the virtual machine's root filesystem. Ignored when runtime is 'none'.

rosetta.description: Use Rosetta for amd64 emulation (requires an M1+ Mac and vmType 'vz')

runtime.description: Container runtime to use. Cannot be changed after the VM is created.

sshConfig.description: Automatically modify ~/.ssh/config to include a config entry for the VM. The SSH config is always generated at $COLIMA_HOME/ssh_config regardless.

sshPort.description: Port number for the VM's SSH server (0 picks a random available port)

vmType.description: Virtual machine type (macOS 13+ only, qemu is always used otherwise). 'vz' is macOS's Virtualization.framework; 'krunkit' runs lightweight VMs on Apple Silicon with a focus on GPU access and is experimental. Cannot be changed after the VM is created.
